en: The image shows the facade of an ornate Renaissance/Baroque urban palace on a narrow street. The main portal is heavily rusticated with large, rough‑cut stone blocks and is flanked by sculpted caryatid‑like figures supporting an elaborate balcony above. On the balcony stand small statues of putti (cherubic children), and more sculptures crown the upper frame of the doorway. The building's walls are plastered and light‑colored, with rectangular windows framed in stone and fitted with wooden shutters; the ground‑floor windows are protected by iron grilles. A rectangular plaque is mounted on the wall to the right of the entrance, but its text is not clearly legible.
